bagPolicy.summary: Only essential items are encouraged, with no large bags or backpacks allowed. All bags must be smaller than 40cm x 35cm x 19cm.
prohibited: Backpacks including holdalls, luggage, computer bags and cushions
Glass, cans, aluminium bottles or thermoses
Video cameras, professional cameras and recording devices
Laptop computers, iPads and Go Pro’s
Large belt buckles, studs, chains and spiked collars
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions for medical requirements and/or special needs, communicated ahead of visit.

parking.note: There are over 600 official car park spaces available on site with CCTV and security patrols. When full, the NCP Car Park next to the Arena is recommended. Pre-booking is not available and parking for cars with wheelchair patrons is on a first-come, first-served basis.

rideshare.note: Dropping off can be made along Railway Street. Collecting people is advised to be done away from the Arena due to heavy traffic.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Utilita Arena Newcastle varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Utilita Arena Newcastle, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Utilita Arena Newcastle's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Utilita Arena Newcastle. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: 1 hour before doors open until the main act is on stage.
